label: Every favouring determination of an actual root is good-general
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for every actual concrete root r at w and every favouring profile phi, if r has the real determination that its own favouring is phi, then phi is good-general: for some scenario and candidates, at least one not a present input, phi depends on betterness with end-realization held fixed (BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS_2). It does not say that any root has a favouring; a root whose favouring factors through its end content does not satisfy it.
